name: TableOfContents
summary: Links to the parts of the page: "on this page" beside or above long content, or a letter jump over an A to Z list. The part being read is marked as the page scrolls. Inside the core router an entry keeps the route and moves focus to its heading; without one it is a plain in-page link. Not for links between pages (use Navigation or SiteHeader) or for a numbered index of pages (use IndexList).
a11y: A `nav` named by its label, with a list of links. The entry being read has `aria-current="location"`, shown by an underline and the text colour, never colour alone. An entry with no target (a letter with no names) is plain text, not a link, so it isn't a tab stop.

keys.action: goes to the entry's part of the page

props.name: items
props.description: The places on the page, in page order.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the list, shown above it and as its navigation name: "On this page". Every word comes from you.

props.name: layout
props.description: `list` (default): one entry per line, for a column beside or above long content. `row`: entries side by side, wrapping, for a short line of sections or a letter jump.

props.name: trackCurrent
props.description: Marks the entry whose part of the page is being read, as the page scrolls (default on).

props.name: anchor
props.description: The id of the element it goes to. Left out, the entry is shown but goes nowhere, such as a letter with no names.

props.name: label
props.description: The words for it: a section's heading, or one letter.
